# Kiwi Sizing

> Kiwi Size Chart & Recommender is a Shopify app that adds customizable size charts and AI-powered size recommendations to product pages. More than 16,000 active shops use Kiwi to reduce size-related returns and increase conversions, and the app has over 500 five-star ratings on the Shopify App Store.

Kiwi offers a free plan, and all paid plans include a 14-day free trial. Merchants can build size charts for any product type (apparel, shoes, rings, hats, pet products, sporting goods), add a personalized size recommender, translate charts for international shoppers, and track sizing analytics.

## Product

- [Home](https://kiwisizing.com/): Overview of Kiwi Size Chart & Recommender for Shopify
- [Features](https://kiwisizing.com/features/): All Kiwi features in one place
- [Professional Size Charts](https://kiwisizing.com/features/size-charts/): Create custom size charts for any product type
- [AI Size Recommender](https://kiwisizing.com/features/ai-size-recommender/): AI-powered personalized fit recommendations for shoppers
- [Apparel Size Recommender](https://kiwisizing.com/features/apparel-size-recommender/): Size recommendations built for clothing stores
- [Custom Size Recommender](https://kiwisizing.com/features/custom-recommender/): Build a recommender for non-apparel products
- [Translations](https://kiwisizing.com/features/size-chart-translations/): Localize size charts and recommenders for international shoppers
- [Analytics](https://kiwisizing.com/features/analytics/): Sizing and recommender analytics for merchants
- [Pricing](https://kiwisizing.com/pricing/): Free plan and paid plans with a 14-day free trial
- [Shopify App Store listing](https://apps.shopify.com/kiwi-sizing): Install Kiwi and read merchant reviews

## Tools

- [Size Chart Conversion Calculator](https://kiwisizing.com/size-chart-conversion-calculator/): Convert international clothing and shoe sizes

## Showcases

- [Size Charts](https://kiwisizing.com/showcases/size-charts/): Real size charts built by Kiwi merchants
- [Recommenders](https://kiwisizing.com/showcases/recommenders/): Real size recommenders built by Kiwi merchants
- [Women's Products](https://kiwisizing.com/showcases/women/): Examples from women's apparel stores
- [Men's Products](https://kiwisizing.com/showcases/men/): Examples from men's apparel stores
- [Shoes](https://kiwisizing.com/showcases/shoes/): Examples from footwear stores
- [Pet Products](https://kiwisizing.com/showcases/pet/): Examples from pet stores
- [Other Products](https://kiwisizing.com/showcases/other/): Examples from other industries

## Size Conversion Guides

- [How To Read a Size Chart](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-to-read-a-size-chart/)
- [How EU Size Converts To US Size](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-eu-size-converts-to-us-size/)
- [How Do EU Shoe Sizes Work?](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-to-eu-shoe-sizes-work/)
- [AU Size To US Size Conversion Guide](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/au-size-to-us-size-conversion-guide/)
- [Japanese Sizes To US Sizes](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-do-japanese-sizes-convert-to-us-sizes/)
- [Korean Sizes To US Sizes](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/korean-size-to-us-conversion-guide/)
- [Chinese Sizes To US Sizes](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/chinese-size-to-us-size-conversions-explained/)
- [The Complete Guide To Ring Size Conversions](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/complete-guide-to-ring-size-conversion/)
- [Are Ring Sizes the Same for Men and Women?](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/are-ring-sizes-the-same-for-men-and-women/)
- [Why Do Shoe Sizes Vary By Brand?](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/why-do-shoe-sizes-vary-by-brand/)
- [What Does B Mean in Shoe Size?](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/what-does-b-mean-in-shoe-size/)
- [What Does Inseam Mean in a Size Chart?](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/what-does-inseam-mean-in-a-size-chart/)

- [What Is Plus Size Clothing and How Is It Measured?](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/what-is-plus-size-clothing-and-measurements/)
- [Big and Tall Size Charts Explained](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/big-and-tall-size-charts-explained/)
- [What Is a Long Torso?](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/what-is-a-long-torso/)

## Measuring Guides

## Returns and Fit

- [How To Add Products To Shopify](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-to-add-products-to-shopify/)
- [How To Add More Than 3 Variants on Shopify](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-to-add-more-than-3-variants-on-shopify/)
- [How To Use Shopify Metrics Effectively](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/shopify-metrics/)
- [Shopify Speed Optimization Guide](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-to-guide-for-shopify-speed-optimization/)
- [How To Reduce Cart Abandonment](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/how-to-reduce-cart-abandonment-for-an-online-store/)

- [Good Business Goals for an Ecommerce Apparel Business](https://kiwisizing.com/blog/good-business-goals-for-e-commerce-apparel/)

## Company

- [About Us](https://kiwisizing.com/about-us/): Company background and mission
- [Partners](https://kiwisizing.com/partners/): Agency, technology, and platform partners
- [Integrations](https://kiwisizing.com/integrations/): Integration and collaboration inquiries

	/* Blog CTA CSS */
	
	.blog-post-cta {
        background: linear-gradient(270deg, rgba(3,41,40,1) 26%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 67%);
        border-radius: 20px;
        padding: 40px;
        display: flex;
        gap: 30px;
				margin-top: 35px;
				margin-bottom: 35px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
        width: 50%;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side img{
        width: 56px;
			margin-left: -5px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 35px !important;
				margin-top: 15px !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side hr{
        background-color: transparent;
        height: 15px;
        border: 0;
				margin: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
        outline: 0;
        box-shadow: inset 0px -4px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 600;
        background-color: #54AE44;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 5px;
        color: #fff;
        padding: 12px 24px 12px 24px;
				text-decoration: none !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a:hover{
        box-shadow: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
        padding: 20px;
        width: 50%;
        background-color: #CFFFDD;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg{
        display: inline-block;
        width: 50px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg path{
            fill: #88D77E;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side hr{
        width: 90px;
        height: 3px;
        background-color: #88D77E;
        display: inline-block;
        transform: translateY(-20px);
        margin-left: 20px !important;
        border: 0;
				margin-top: 0 !important;
				margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p{
        font-size: 20px;
				color: #30533F;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:first-of-type{
        margin-top: 15px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 767px){
        .blog-post-cta {
            padding: 35px 25px;
            gap: 0px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
            width: 100%;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
            font-size: 30px !important;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
            display: block;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
            width: 100%;
            margin-top: 30px;
            padding: 15px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:last-of-type{
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }
	
	/* END Blog CTA CSS */

	/* Blog CTA CSS */
	
	.blog-post-cta {
        background: linear-gradient(270deg, rgba(3,41,40,1) 26%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 67%);
        border-radius: 20px;
        padding: 40px;
        display: flex;
        gap: 30px;
				margin-top: 35px;
				margin-bottom: 35px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
        width: 50%;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side img{
        width: 56px;
			margin-left: -5px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 35px !important;
				margin-top: 15px !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side hr{
        background-color: transparent;
        height: 15px;
        border: 0;
				margin: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
        outline: 0;
        box-shadow: inset 0px -4px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 600;
        background-color: #54AE44;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 5px;
        color: #fff;
        padding: 12px 24px 12px 24px;
				text-decoration: none !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a:hover{
        box-shadow: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
        padding: 20px;
        width: 50%;
        background-color: #CFFFDD;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg{
        display: inline-block;
        width: 50px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg path{
            fill: #88D77E;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side hr{
        width: 90px;
        height: 3px;
        background-color: #88D77E;
        display: inline-block;
        transform: translateY(-20px);
        margin-left: 20px !important;
        border: 0;
				margin-top: 0 !important;
				margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p{
        font-size: 20px;
				color: #30533F;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:first-of-type{
        margin-top: 15px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 767px){
        .blog-post-cta {
            padding: 35px 25px;
            gap: 0px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
            width: 100%;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
            font-size: 30px !important;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
            display: block;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
            width: 100%;
            margin-top: 30px;
            padding: 15px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:last-of-type{
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }
	
	/* END Blog CTA CSS */

  (function () {
    // The real numbers are already in the HTML, so search engines and AI see them.

    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

    var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.kiwi-stats .kiwi-count');
    var fmt = function (n, dec) {
      return dec ? n.toFixed(dec) : Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
    };

    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        var el = entry.target;
        var to = parseFloat(el.dataset.to);
        var dec = parseInt(el.dataset.dec || '0', 10);
        var start = null, dur = 1400;
        var step = function (t) {
          if (!start) start = t;
          var p = Math.min((t - start) / dur, 1);
          var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
          el.textContent = fmt(to * eased, dec);
          if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
        io.unobserve(el);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });

    counters.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  })();

	/* Blog CTA CSS */
	
	.blog-post-cta {
        background: linear-gradient(270deg, rgba(3,41,40,1) 26%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 67%);
        border-radius: 20px;
        padding: 40px;
        display: flex;
        gap: 30px;
				margin-top: 35px;
				margin-bottom: 35px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
        width: 50%;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side img{
        width: 56px;
			margin-left: -5px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 35px !important;
				margin-top: 15px !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side hr{
        background-color: transparent;
        height: 15px;
        border: 0;
				margin: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
        outline: 0;
        box-shadow: inset 0px -4px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 600;
        background-color: #54AE44;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 5px;
        color: #fff;
        padding: 12px 24px 12px 24px;
				text-decoration: none !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a:hover{
        box-shadow: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
        padding: 20px;
        width: 50%;
        background-color: #CFFFDD;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg{
        display: inline-block;
        width: 50px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg path{
            fill: #88D77E;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side hr{
        width: 90px;
        height: 3px;
        background-color: #88D77E;
        display: inline-block;
        transform: translateY(-20px);
        margin-left: 20px !important;
        border: 0;
				margin-top: 0 !important;
				margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p{
        font-size: 20px;
				color: #30533F;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:first-of-type{
        margin-top: 15px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 767px){
        .blog-post-cta {
            padding: 35px 25px;
            gap: 0px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
            width: 100%;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
            font-size: 30px !important;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
            display: block;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
            width: 100%;
            margin-top: 30px;
            padding: 15px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:last-of-type{
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }
	
	/* END Blog CTA CSS */

	/* Blog CTA CSS */
	
	.blog-post-cta {
        background: linear-gradient(270deg, rgba(3,41,40,1) 26%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 67%);
        border-radius: 20px;
        padding: 40px;
        display: flex;
        gap: 30px;
				margin-top: 35px;
				margin-bottom: 35px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
        width: 50%;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side img{
        width: 56px;
			margin-left: -5px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 35px !important;
				margin-top: 15px !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side hr{
        background-color: transparent;
        height: 15px;
        border: 0;
				margin: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
        outline: 0;
        box-shadow: inset 0px -4px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 600;
        background-color: #54AE44;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 5px;
        color: #fff;
        padding: 12px 24px 12px 24px;
				text-decoration: none !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a:hover{
        box-shadow: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
        padding: 20px;
        width: 50%;
        background-color: #CFFFDD;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg{
        display: inline-block;
        width: 50px;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side svg path{
            fill: #88D77E;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side hr{
        width: 90px;
        height: 3px;
        background-color: #88D77E;
        display: inline-block;
        transform: translateY(-20px);
        margin-left: 20px !important;
        border: 0;
				margin-top: 0 !important;
				margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p{
        font-size: 20px;
				color: #30533F;
    }
    .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:first-of-type{
        margin-top: 15px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 767px){
        .blog-post-cta {
            padding: 35px 25px;
            gap: 0px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side{
            width: 100%;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side h4{
            font-size: 30px !important;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side p{
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-left-side a{
            display: block;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side{
            width: 100%;
            margin-top: 30px;
            padding: 15px;
        }
        .blog-post-cta .cta-right-side p:last-of-type{
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }
	
	/* END Blog CTA CSS */
